annotations.title: Design Search — real page, app screen and slide references

description:
Find real designs to build from: screenshots of live web pages, single page sections, mobile app screens and presentation slides, each returned with the design values behind it — colours, fonts and font sizes, or the components of an app screen — and, for page sections, the HTML. Articles, guidelines and tutorials on the same query come back alongside as ranked web results.

USE FOR building or restyling an interface or a deck from real references instead of from memory: "pricing section for a SaaS landing page", "iOS onboarding screen", "seed round pitch deck", "dark analytics dashboard". Describe what is being built. For photos, diagrams and other general images use `image_search`; for ordinary web pages use `search`.

Each image comes back as a link to the screenshot and a thumbnail. The links are signed and time-limited — view or download them now rather than storing them.

A page section or a slide names the page or deck it belongs to: a `group_id`, its position, and how many images the group holds. To get the rest in order, call again with `images.group_id` set to that id and `images.count` set to the group's total, or to 100 if the group is larger — 100 is the most one call returns, and left at its default the call returns only the first 5. That call needs no `query`.

The response is large, so switch off what the task does not need: `web_search.enable: false` when only the designs matter, `images.enable: false` when only the writing does, `images.snippet.enable: false` to leave out the HTML, `images.design_facts: false` to leave out the values.

keywords: design reference, UI design, UX, web design, landing page, page section, hero, pricing section, dashboard, app screen, mobile UI, slide, pitch deck, presentation, design tokens, colors, fonts, typography, HTML snippet, inspiration, mockup

images.description: The design references, and what comes with each. On by default — omit to use the server defaults.

count.description: Image results to return (1-100). For a group lookup, set it to the group's total to get the whole page or deck — or to 100 for a larger group, which is the most one call returns.

design_facts.description: Return each image's design values — colours, fonts and font sizes, or an app screen's components.

group_id.description: Return the images of this group, in group order, instead of searching by `query`. Takes the `group_id` returned with a page section or a slide.

snippet.description: Reusable HTML, for the image results that have it (page sections).

max_tokens.description: Max tokens of code per image (100-100000).

query.description: What is being designed, e.g. 'pricing section for a SaaS landing page'. Max 500 chars. Required unless `images.group_id` is set.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (1-60). Defaults to 30s if unset.

web_search.description: The web pages on the same query — articles, guidelines, tutorials. On by default; these options never affect the image results.

end_time.description: Upper bound for web results, ISO 8601.

exclude_domains.description: Drop web results from these domains. Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

full_content.description: Cleaned page body per web result. Heavier than `highlight`.

include_domains.description: Only return web results from these domains. Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

language.description: Languages to filter web results by, as ISO 639-1 codes.

start_time.description: Lower bound for web results, ISO 8601.

time_basis.description: Which timestamp the web-result time window filters against.

time_range.description: Relative time window for web results. The absolute range wins if both are given.
